import re
import pytest
from target import url_basename

# Old implementation regex (the reference behavior)
_OLD_REGEX = re.compile(
    r'(?:https?:|)//[^/]+/(?:[^?#]+/)?([^/?#]+)/?(?:[?#]|$)'
)

def _old_url_basename(url: str) -> str:
    m = _OLD_REGEX.match(url)
    return '' if not m else m.group(1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url",
    [
        # Simple paths
        "http://example.com/foo",
        "http://example.com/foo/",
        "http://example.com/foo?x=1",
        "http://example.com/foo#frag",
        "https://example.com/foo/bar",
        "https://example.com/foo/bar/",
        "https://example.com/foo/bar?x=1",
        "https://example.com/foo/bar#frag",
        "http://example.com/a/b/c",
        "http://example.com/a/b/c?x=1",
        "http://example.com/a/b/c#section",
        # Multiple segments before the basename
        "http://example.com/one/two/three/four",
        "http://example.com/one/two/three/four?query=val",
        "http://example.com/one/two/three/four#hash",
        # Trailing slash after basename
        "http://example.com/foo/bar/",
        "http://example.com/foo/bar/?x=1",
        # No path (should return empty string)
        "http://example.com",
        "http://example.com/",
        "http://example.com?x=1",
        "http://example.com#frag",
        # Scheme‑less URLs
        "//example.com/foo/bar",
        "//example.com/foo/bar?x=1",
        "//example.com/foo/bar#frag",
        # Non‑http scheme (should not match, return empty)
        "ftp://example.com/foo/bar",
        "mailto:user@example.com",
        # Edge cases with unusual characters
        "http://example.com/!$&'()*+,;=:@/basename",
        "http://example.com/space%20in%20path/basename",
    ],
)
def test_url_basename_behaviour_matches_old_implementation(url):
    assert url_basename(url) == _old_url_basename(url)
